# Infographic Studio design system

> Design tokens, React UI components, an infographic vocabulary (`ig-*` HTML/CSS components) and a chart library. Imported in code as `@ds/*`. Locales: es, en. Themes: light, dark. Read `README.md` first; paths below are relative to `design-system/`.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): index of where everything lives, naming conventions and rules for agents

## Tokens (source of truth: DTCG JSON; CSS is generated, never edit it)

- [tokens/primitives.tokens.json](tokens/primitives.tokens.json): colour, font, spacing and radius primitives
- [tokens/semantic.tokens.json](tokens/semantic.tokens.json): layout, component and focus tokens
- [tokens/typography.tokens.json](tokens/typography.tokens.json): type scale
- [tokens/themes/light.tokens.json](tokens/themes/light.tokens.json): light theme values
- [tokens/themes/dark.tokens.json](tokens/themes/dark.tokens.json): dark theme values
- [tokens/build/tokens.css](tokens/build/tokens.css): generated `--ds-*` custom properties
- [tokens/build/themes.css](tokens/build/themes.css): generated theme overrides

## App UI components (React)

- [ui/index.ts](ui/index.ts): barrel export of all primitives and composites
- [ui/primitives/](ui/primitives/): Badge, Button, Card, Checkbox, Dialog, Divider, Field, Icon, Input, Label, Link, Note, Select, Skeleton, Spinner, Switch, Text, Textarea, VisuallyHidden
- [ui/composites/](ui/composites/): AppHeader, ConfirmDialog, EmptyState, ErrorMessage, ErrorState, FilterBar, GenerationProgress, InfographicCard, LanguageToggle, PromptComposer, SearchBar, ShareDialog, UserMenu
- [components/](components/): one `<Name>.md` spec per component (props, variants, accessibility, when to use); infographic ones are `ig-<name>.md`

## Infographic vocabulary

- [infographic/manifest.ts](infographic/manifest.ts): `COMPONENTS`, the allowed `ig-*` classes, variants and data props
- [infographic/validate.ts](infographic/validate.ts): `validateFragment`, markup must pass it
- [infographic/render.ts](infographic/render.ts): `buildDocument`, wraps a fragment into a full document
- [infographic/document.ts](infographic/document.ts): locales, themes, CSP
- [infographic/components.css](infographic/components.css): `ig-*` styles (partials in `infographic/css/`)
- [examples/](examples/): reference infographics, `<name>.<locale>.html` plus `<name>.charts.<locale>.json`

## Charts

- [charts/index.ts](charts/index.ts): `validateChartSpec`, `renderChart`, `expandCharts`
- [charts/schema/](charts/schema/): zod specs per chart type (column, donut, line, pictogram, ranking, scatter, stacked, treemap)
- [charts/render/](charts/render/): SVG renderers per chart type
- [../CHART_LIBRARY_PLAN.md](../CHART_LIBRARY_PLAN.md): chart library plan and progress

## Conventions

- Tokens: `--ds-<group>-<name>`; prefer semantic groups (surface, text, border, accent, danger, focus) over `--ds-color-*` primitives; never hard-code colours
- Infographic classes: BEM with `ig-` prefix (`ig-block`, `ig-block__element`, `ig-block--variant`); chart ids match `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/` and are referenced by `data-chart`
- After editing tokens run `pnpm tokens:build`; verify with `pnpm tokens:check` and `pnpm contrast:check`
